beskrivning: ECM Knowledge Library — serverdistribuerat regelpaket. Uppdateras utan appändring: redigera filen (eller montera en ConfigMap över den i klustret) och starta om tjänsten. Klienten hämtar paketet vid inloggning och faller tillbaka till sitt inbyggda standardpaket offline.

Warranty.detaljVidBrist: Warranty cases require a documented odometer reading.
Warranty cases require a checked service history.
State the claim or warranty number — from the scanned work order or the recorded payer.
Record the payer — track, name and reference — before closing.

Goodwill.detaljVidBrist: Goodwill cases require a documented odometer reading.
Goodwill cases require a checked service history.
Goodwill requires the grantor's documented approval before closing.

Insurance.detaljVidBrist: Insurance cases require a claim number (read from the work order).
Record the insurer — name and claim reference — before closing.

Complaint.detaljVidBrist: Complaint cases require a checked history (previous repairs and attempts).

Used-vehicle warranty.detaljVidBrist: Used-vehicle warranty cases require a documented odometer reading.

Body damage warranty.detaljVidBrist: Record the warranty administrator — name and reference — before closing.
Body damage warranty cases require a documented odometer reading.
Body damage warranty cases require photographs of the damage.

Extended warranty.detaljVidBrist: Record the warranty provider — name and reference — before closing.
External warranties require a claim or authorization number before repair is reimbursed.
Extended warranty cases require a documented odometer reading.
Extended warranty terms often condition cover on service history — check and document it.

Leasing or fleet.detaljVidBrist: Record the leasing or fleet company — name and reference — before closing.
Leasing and fleet cases require a documented odometer reading.
